title: mini-gurke
about: Made by [Quirin](https://fischerq.de) for [Ludum Dare 60](https://ldjam.com), at the [in-person jam](../event/) hosted by [Munich eSports](https://munich-esports.de) at [Die Gamerei](https://www.games-bavaria.com/die-gamerei/) in Munich.
plan_note: Built on a Claude Max (10x) subscription, which is a flat monthly fee. The dollar figures are what the same tokens would cost at API list prices. The plan-usage figures show how much of the subscription's 5-hour and weekly limits each prompt used. Those limits are account-wide, so any other Claude use at the same time is included.
